question:
A traveling salesman must visit 7 customers at 7 different locations, and the (symmetric) distance matrix is as follows:

|  | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 1 | - | 86 | 49 | 57 | 31 | 69 | 50 |
| 2 |  | - | 68 | 79 | 93 | 24 | 5 |
| 3 |  |  | - | 16 | 7 | 72 | 67 |
| 4 |  |  |  | - | 90 | 69 | 1 |
| 5 |  |  |  |  | - | 86 | 59 |
| 6 |  |  |  |  |  | - | 81 |

Develop a mathematical program to determine the visiting order starting from location 1 and ending at location 1, in order to minimize the traveling distance, and solve it using COPTPY.

DATA = {
    "nodes": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7],
    "start": 1,
    "n": 7,
    # symmetric distance matrix stored as (i,j) -> distance, i != j
    "dist": {
        (1, 2): 86, (1, 3): 49, (1, 4): 57, (1, 5): 31, (1, 6): 69, (1, 7): 50,
        (2, 3): 68, (2, 4): 79, (2, 5): 93, (2, 6): 24, (2, 7): 5,
        (3, 4): 16, (3, 5): 7,  (3, 6): 72, (3, 7): 67,
        (4, 5): 90, (4, 6): 69, (4, 7): 1,
        (5, 6): 86, (5, 7): 59,
        (6, 7): 81,
    },
    "mzt_lower": 1,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    n = d["n"]
    nodes = list(d["nodes"])
    start = d["start"]

    # full symmetric distance lookup
    dist = {}
    for (i, j), val in d["dist"].items():
        dist[(i, j)] = val
        dist[(j, i)] = val

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=nodes, ordered=True)
    model.A = pyo.Set(
        dimen=2,
        initialize=[(i, j) for i in nodes for j in nodes if i != j],
        ordered=True,
    )
    model.NC = pyo.Set(
        initialize=[i for i in nodes if i != start],
        ordered=True,
    )
    model.NC2 = pyo.Set(
        dimen=2,
        initialize=[(i, j) for i in nodes if i != start
                    for j in nodes if j != start and i != j],
        ordered=True,
    )

    def dist_rule(m, i, j):
        return dist[(i, j)]

    model.dist = pyo.Param(model.A, rule=dist_rule)

    # x[i,j] = 1 if arc i->j is used
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.Binary)

    # u[i] = position/order of node i in the tour (MTZ), for i != start
    def u_bounds(m, i):
        return (d["mzt_lower"], n)

    model.u = pyo.Var(model.NC, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=u_bounds)

    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(m.dist[i, j] * m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.A)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Each node left exactly once
    def out_rule(m, i):
        return sum(m.x[i, j] for j in m.N if j != i) == 1

    model.out_degree = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=out_rule)

    # Each node entered exactly once
    def in_rule(m, j):
        return sum(m.x[i, j] for i in m.N if i != j) == 1

    model.in_degree = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=in_rule)

    # MTZ subtour elimination (i, j in NC, i != j): u_i - u_j + n*x_ij <= n-1
    def mtz_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.u[i] - m.u[j] + n * m.x[i, j] <= n - 1

    model.mtz = pyo.Constraint(model.NC2, rule=mtz_rule)

    return model

  x[i,j] in {0,1}          : arc (i,j) is traversed (i != j).
